QuestInfo.name: Well-Behaved Student
QuestInfo.1: Kinu told you to sit down and focus on the class. Press X in front of the wooden chair, sit down, and PAY ATTENTION.
QuestInfo.2: Sit in the chair and focus on Kinu's class.

1.0: I want to see some major concentration when you take my lessons. Tell me your name. And call me Commander!\r\n#L0##b#h0#... uh, Commander!#l\n#k
1.1: I'm going to try to make this lecture understandable, but it might be over your head.

default.0: First up: chairs. Press X in front of any chair to sit down. If you own one, it's the same deal. X marks the butt.
